yt_description:
Ever seen an algorithm that goes back and forth? 🤔 Meet Cocktail Sort (also known as bidirectional bubble sort or cocktail shaker sort)! 🚀 It's like Bubble Sort, but it cleans up both ends of the unsorted list, making it a bit more efficient.  In this video, we'll visualize exactly how it works, step-by-step, with stunning graphics that'll make sorting data fun!  Perfect for beginners and anyone looking to understand sorting algorithms better.  Dive in and see how this 'shaker' gets your data in order!
